name: @one/editor-scene
description: The scene editor's super-user SDK7 scene: selection, transform gizmos and the editor camera, driven by the Creator Hub editor (apps/ui3/src/editor) over the editor bus. Runs on an Explorer with the editor console commands, which the pinned web artifact lacks. `pnpm run build` exports it as a static realm: its files into ui3/public/editor-scene, served by Sites at /editor-scene/, and its about into ui3/src/editor/editor-scene-realm.json, which Sites serves at /editor-scene/EditorScene/about with the deployment's own origin in the scene urn.

scripts.build: sdk-commands build --production && rm -rf ../public/editor-scene && sdk-commands export-static --destination ../public/editor-scene --realmName EditorScene --baseUrl /editor-scene/ --commsAdapter offline:offline --timestamp 0 && mv ../public/editor-scene/EditorScene/about ../src/editor/editor-scene-realm.json && rmdir ../public/editor-scene/EditorScene && node ../../sites/scripts/sync-ui3-public.mts
